text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our day off, and I'm accompanying Manhattan Cafe to the antique cafe she often visits.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What should I get today… Oh.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing. I just saw a coffee blend that takes me back a little…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you like to try some with me? It tastes good, I assure you…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll go ahead and order it…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This aroma… Lend your ear to the music… and free your mind of any thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Coupled with the comforting atmosphere, the fragrant coffee puts me completely at ease…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I relax, I come to hear a strange melody playing. I open my eyes to find…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you've found your way here too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure… I drank some of that coffee, closed my eyes, and the next thing I knew I was here…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk around in search of an exit, but can't find anything that looks like a way out. In that case…
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we have some fun?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was thinking the same thing… This is an amusement park, after all…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So, where should we go?
choice_data_list: Let's go into the haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A haunted house… within an illusion? Hehe, we should probably proceed with caution…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This illusion is very polished… It's so atmospheric.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's a little too polished… I start to feel a chill running down my spine and—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I'm overwhelmed by the sensation of falling into a bottomless pit! I throw my hands up in a desperate panic!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I've got you! This way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe yanks me up, and I finally find my footing again.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think we'd better watch where we step here… Follow me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tap, tap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Manhattan Cafe leads the way, glittering light trails her every step. I follow after her, guided by her light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The scene feels straight out of a dream. Maybe it's because of the terrifying experience I just had, but it feels like each speck of light shines brighter as if to balance things out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling more comfortable, I grow a little sleepy… And when I open my eyes again…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that… I wonder what we'll be able to see from the top…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk over to the empty ferris wheel and climb into a carriage. It lurches and sways as it makes the ascent, and just as we reach the top…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear a loud noise! I have no idea what's going on, but I've got to keep Manhattan Cafe safe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …It's all right. Look up…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fireworks… They're so colorful…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It must have been the fireworks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fireworks explode, scattering their shimmering sparks. As I watch them, I feel my heart growing calm.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you for protecting me earlier…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was happy… that you tried to keep me safe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's somehow rewarding to hear Manhattan Cafe express her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling more comfortable, I grow a little sleepy… And when I open my eyes again…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Welcome back. I just got here myself…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It must have been the taste of the coffee. It caused our senses to resonate and whisked us off to that illusion…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And the source of the illusion was my own memories… I used to drink this coffee all the time with my parents.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tasting it again brought back the joy I felt in my childhood…
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun too.
I had a lot of fun too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You see, it's very… very rare for two people to experience the same illusion…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk home, and though it doesn't seem Manhattan Cafe notices, her shadow sways as if it were dancing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's actually quite happy to have shared an experience with someone.
